_comment: Example DVT Execution Report (report mode). Demonstrates every reportSections block kind. Copy this and edit. Build with: node build_dvt.js dvt_data_report_example.json

meta.title: DESIGN VERIFICATION TEST — EXECUTION REPORT
meta.subtitle: Example subtitle — what this unit is and what changed
meta.creator: Engineering

coverRows.label: Result summary
coverRows.value: <e.g., 7 PASS; 2 pass by reference; 2 non-blocking; 1 pending>

reportSections.name: 1. Summary
body: A 'narrative' block renders a heading, an optional italic intro, and one paragraph per string in 'body'.
Use it for the executive summary, background, or any prose section.

reportSections.name: 2. Sub-component DVTs
reportSections.intro: A 'subcomponents' block lists referenced documents. Each ref renders a bold title, a 'Reference:' link line, and an optional passCriteria note.

refs.title: Example Sub-assembly DVT
refs.passCriteria: Latest released sub-assembly DVT on record. Sign-off recorded in that document.

reportSections.name: 3. Scope: Required Tests & Rationale
reportSections.intro: A 'scope' block renders an optional trigger legend table and a required-activities matrix.

reportSections.name: 4. Units Under Test
reportSections.intro: A 'units' block renders a free-form table from 'columns' + 'rows'.

reportSections.name: 5. Test Results
reportSections.intro: A 'tests' block renders a Ref / Header / Brief / Criteria / Result table (no P/F checkbox — this is a report). Put the verdict in 'measure'.

steps.brief: Imperative one-line description of what was done.
Closed by reference to an external certification.

reportSections.name: 6. Anomalies, Recommendations & Conclusion
reportSections.intro: An 'anomalies' block renders an anomalies table, a deviations paragraph, a recommendations list, and a conclusion.
reportSections.deviations: Deviations: D1 example deviation and its justification.
conclusion: Overall verdict tally and the readiness recommendation go here.

reportSections.name: Appendix A — Example Evidence
reportSections.intro: A 'figures' block embeds images (auto-scaled) with numbered captions. Paths are relative to this data file.

figures.caption: Fig. 1 — example figure with an explanatory caption.
